name: paper2html
title_zh: 把论文 PDF 变成可直接发布的单页项目主页
tagline_zh: 投完稿顺手把 PDF 拖进去，出来一个自带样式、可挂 GitHub Pages 的 index.html。
tagline_en: Drop in a paper PDF, get a styled, self-contained index.html ready for GitHub Pages. Zero frontend work—reviewers.
desc_en: Convert an academic paper PDF into a publish-ready, self-contained single-page **project homepage** (a self-contained index.html) — the kind of paper landing page researchers host on GitHub Pages. Triggers when the user says "turn a paper into a project page/webpage", "paper2html", "generate a paper landing page / project page", "turn this PDF into an HTML page", "paper to webpage", or "make a pap
why_zh: 它不渲染成普通网页，而是按学术项目主页的惯例组织：标题、摘要、图表、引用分区，且所有资源内联。
why_en: It structures output like a real academic project page—title, abstract, figures, citations—and inlines all assets, so one file.
limit_zh: 只吃学术论文 PDF，且依赖本机安装的 LaTeX 工具链（pdflatex 等）来解析公式；图表提取限于 PDF 内。
limit_en: Academic PDFs only; needs local LaTeX toolchain for formula parsing. Extracts only embedded vector figures—scanned/image PDFs skip figures. Output.
